div.div:
in_preparation
Part C: en preparación | Badge: [en preparación]
--------------------------------------------------
• Sack born at wet mill in 60 kg reference (ASM-150)
• Scale weight measured and recorded with 1 decimal
• Confirms drying lot (links to drying variables, ASM-096)
• Code bound from pre-printed batch (80 bits, ASM-094)
• Encrypted outbox buffers until cellular uplink (ASM-079)
• Responsible: Farmer (Farmer App, field pool, no MFA)

Part C: en viaje al acopio | Badge: [en viaje]

Part C: en acopio (rechazado) | Badge: [rechazado]

• Rejected sack preserves complete historical audit trail
• Responsible: Center Operator (Logistics App, TOTP MFA)

div.div:
FIVE NON-STATE-CHANGING EVENTS (DOCS SEC 3.2)
These events record operational milestones and corrections with date, time, and responsible,
but do not alter the lifecycle state of the sack:
1. arrived_at_center:
Transporter arrives at collection center yard and initiates physical handover.
Records recorded_at on transporter phone and links open trip to center gate arrival (A10 sec 7).
2. assigned_to_trip:
Collection-center operator stages accepted sacks onto an outbound center_to_port trip.
Required guard condition before departed_to_port can be executed by transporter.
3. code_replaced:
A damaged or illegible physical label is replaced with a fresh code from the center reserve.
The retired code is marked void in sack_codes and permanently returns 'not found' at lookup.
4. weight_corrected:
Compensating event correcting scale typographical error. Must be recorded by the same role
and scope that entered original, citing mandatory reason (ASM-151). Retains full audit history.
5. outcome_corrected:
Compensating event correcting reception outcome error (e.g. misclassified rejection).
Same role, scope, and reason rule applies (ASM-151).
Append-Only Immutability Contract:
Zero events are edited or deleted. Every physical act is persisted immutably in sack_event_log.
State is derived by replaying history.

div.div:
OFFLINE ORDERING & TIMESTAMP RECONCILIATION (ASM-152, SEC 3.3, SEC 4)
Every mobile and field actor operates offline on mountain roads. Events reach AWS out of sequence.
Four deterministic rules govern state resolution:
Rule 1: Refuse Only What Caller Cannot Do
API rejects requests only for invalid credentials/role, unknown/void code, or schema invalidity.
Once an event represents a physical act that already occurred, it is unconditionally persisted.
Rule 2: Order by Time of the Act (Deterministic Fold)
Current sack state is recomputed from scratch by replaying the complete event log ordered strictly
by recorded_at ASC, then event_id ASC. Result is mathematically invariant to network arrival order!
Rule 3: Physical Receiver is Authoritative
A custody transition recorded by the physical holder (T3, T4, T7, T8) is applied immediately even if
upstream departure or pickup is still queued in a disconnected phone buffer. Missing steps flagged.
Rule 4: Pre-Registration Events Wait in Pending State
An event arriving for an issued code prior to its sack_registered upload is held in pending status
and applied automatically when the registration drains from the farmer's outbox.
Timestamp Rules (Sec 4):
• recorded_at: Device UTC timestamp to millisecond taken at moment of physical act.
Formatted in America/Bogota (UTC-5) for display (ASM-007).
• received_at: Server UTC timestamp applied by API upon durable persistence in DynamoDB.
• Clock Skew Check: If recorded_at > received_at + 5 min, flagged as phone clock ahead (PD-151).

DATA SCHEMA & STORE ARCHITECTURE (DOCS SEC 4, SEC 10) [KMS KEYS: BOX D06 | VPC TIERS: BOX D04]
Mandatory Event Record Schema (Sec 4):
• event_id: UUID idempotency key generated on device (A10 sec 2)
• event_type: Transition event or non-state-changing event type
• sack_codes: List of Crockford Base32 sack codes covered in batch act
• trip_id: Trip reference (empty for sack_registered)
• recorded_at / received_at: Device act timestamp / API persistence time
• responsible_subject_id / role: Opaque pseudonym & Cognito role (ASM-091)
• device_id / center_id: App installation UUID & collection center ID
• latitude / longitude: GNSS fix coordinates for transporter custody acts
• weight_kg / drying_lot_id: Measured weight & drying lot identifier
• outcome / reason / receiver_reference: Status, rationale, port receipt ref
DynamoDB Stores (Application Tables; KMS Keys Covered by Box D06):
• sack_event_log: PK event_id | Immutable event log | KMS 'records' [Box D06] | Streams enabled
• sacks: PK sack_id | GSI sack_code, farm_id | Current state, version, flags | KMS 'records' [Box D06]
• sack_history: PK sack_id, SK recorded_at#event_id | Deterministic fold source | KMS 'records' [Box D06]
• trips: PK trip_id | Transporter custody legs & vehicles | KMS 'records' [Box D06]
• transport_positions: PK trip_id, SK sequence_no | 5-min GNSS fixes | KMS 'telemetry' [Box D06] (PD-110)
• buyer_view: PK sack_code | Projected public view | KMS 'public_view' [Box D06] (ASM-154)
Disaster Recovery Objectives (Sec 9, ASM-157, PD-153):
• RPO = 15 min: sack-exporter streams JSON Lines to S3 export prefix (ADR-001) every 60 s;
CloudWatch alarm fires if iterator age > 5 min.
• RTO = 4 h: Public lookup runs serverless via CloudFront + Lambda URL + buyer_view;
completely decoupled from application API!
